parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: HAZOP: Node V-001 and crude inlet line (CASE-01). The implied design intent is inlet/separator pressure held within its operating range, with the PV-101 loop as the listed control element. Guideword LESS/LOW gives the deviation low pressure (CASE-02). Causes: PV-101 loop failing open and line leakage/fracture (P2). Consequence of interest: unit shutdown (P3); other consequences, such as loss of containment from a fracture, are not characterized. Safeguards: none listed (CASE-03, P1). Probability: at the decision point there was no diagnostic trend, verified initiating fault, or confirmed event (P3), so the estimate stays at a base rate for random failures. Using generic, non-plant orders of magnitude, a BPCS loop failure is roughly 0.1-1/yr across all modes (fail-open is only a fraction), and a line fracture is rarer. Over about 0.08 yr, with escalation to shutdown less than certain, this gives roughly 1-5%, point estimate 3%. Missing safeguards reduce the chance of early correction but do not raise initiating frequency. Predictability: the scenario class was foreseeable at the hazard-identification level, since P1/P2 analyze it explicitly with causes. However, no leading indicator pointed to occurrence within the 30-day window, so window-specific predictability is low (about 10%). Qualitative risk: likelihood is low over the horizon. Severity is not supplied, so no firm matrix cell can be assigned; if consequences are limited to shutdown/production loss, risk is low-to-medium, with priority raised by the absence of any safeguard. Recommendation: close the P1 action (verify/enable the PIT-101 low-pressure alarm with a documented setpoint and operator response). Also consider PV-101 fail-position/proof testing and line-integrity inspection. Negligence: the pre-event record shows the hazard was recognized and a proportionate action recommended, with no ignored warning. No negligence is attributable, although P1 implementation status is unknown. The post-decision shutdown report was excluded and does not update these estimates.
